Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.cause: Fungal pathogen (Puccinia sorghi), spreads via airborne spores.
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.treatment: Apply Mancozeb or Kresoxim-methyl 44.3% SC foliar spray at the first sign of disease to prevent spread to top leaves.
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.prevention: Plant rust-resistant maize varieties where available. Practice crop rotation with non-host crops like pulses.

Corn_(maize)___healthy.treatment: No treatment required. Continue standard agricultural practices.
Corn_(maize)___healthy.prevention: Maintain regular watering and fertilization schedules.

Tomato___Early_blight.cause: Fungal infection (Alternaria solani), spreads in warm humid conditions.
Tomato___Early_blight.treatment: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2g per liter of water. Apply twice at weekly intervals upon noticing disease incidence.
Tomato___Early_blight.prevention: Rotate crops yearly. Ensure adequate spacing between plants for airflow.

Tomato___healthy.treatment: No treatment required. Continue standard agricultural practices.
Tomato___healthy.prevention: Maintain regular watering and fertilization schedules.
